basic_info.description: Stylish two-level view condo nestled in highly sought-after Corona Heights. This spacious condo features 3 bedrooms, 2 full baths, 1-car parking, elevator, and a beautifully landscaped deeded yard and deck. The main level offers an open-concept kitchen with stainless steel appliances, a generous island, and a dining area perfect for entertaining. The expansive living room is highlighted by soaring ceilings, a cozy corner fireplace, and stunning views. A bedroom, full bath, and in-unit laundry complete this floor. Upstairs, the primary suite includes a luxurious bathroom with a separate soaking tub, walk-in shower, and skylight. A third bedroom is also located on this level. Set on a charming, quiet street in a fantastic neighborhood, this home offers comfort, convenience, and classic San Francisco appeal.
